question:
The given pie chart represents the distribution of the percentage of sales of a particular brand of a bike from five showrooms, A, B, C, D and E during 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41269603b44f3e5f3a7b4492179abe10e873ec3505f6b3277b77d21ced1e2725.png] 

What is the central angle of the sector corresponding to the sales from showroom B?
solution:
**Formula used:**

Central angle = frac{{percent}}{100}times 360

**Calculation:**

Central angle = (22)/(100)times 360= 79.2circ

**∴ The central angle of the sector corresponding to the sales from showroom B is 79.2°**
